review.description: Contributor reconciliation behavior remains accurate; the new summary, prepared-update and opt-in lifecycle assertions are mapped into their existing owning contracts and retain real-host gaps.
review.implementation: Catalog and UI assertion inventories gain precise test anchors; no specification parser, fingerprint policy, adoption list or verifier runner changed. Mixed UI decisions cover every direct contract without adoption exceptions.
review.tests: Fresh tooling suites execute all user-flow and test_specs modules. Snapshot/boundary regressions remain product tests; their success is not treated as a change to the specification gate or live host acceptance.
